title: Doty and Lear spread quackery around the Majestic 12 era

tellings.quote:
promoted but with all sorts of quackery
and you have Air Force Office of Special
Investigations agent and other
counterintel people like Rick Dodie
being like there are six alien being and
like John Lear saying you know there's a
soul catcher on the moon

plain: In the 1980s, while the Majestic 12 papers were going around (documents said to describe a secret US group handling UFO matters), the subject was promoted alongside what Michels calls "all sorts of quackery." He says an agent of the Air Force Office of Special Investigations, the Air Force's own investigative and counterintelligence service, named Richard Doty claimed there were six alien beings, and a man named John Lear said there was a "soul catcher" on the Moon. Michels tells this himself, as an example of how the topic was muddied in that decade.
